scope.mode: Read-only review of readers and records. Only this JSON is authored.
scope.excluded_other_review: Bacon coverage at baf7b75 is separate and is not duplicated.
scope.later_editorial_boundary: Later changes to 4/5/6/8/9/A/J are excluded. Overlapping reviewed readers retain the selected-source authority in that later snapshot. No conflicting source header was found. This does not clear the later editorial bodies.

methods.reading: Read all 101 changed complete paragraphs, table contexts and authority comments at the corrected commit, including paired provenance paragraphs and surrounding historical scopes. Read the actual two diffs and relevant complete source routines as Git text.
methods.static_comparisons: Independently reconstructed each initial application from frozen input, exact edit operations and seven rewraps. Checked manifest reader/pass-record hashes and follow-on correction hashes. Compared fences, non-authority comments and links directly.

identity_records.interpretation: The 52 null entries are explicitly untracked/generated artifacts or non-file path mentions, not 52 missing source proofs. Generator-backed includes and foreign Thorium source retain their recorded classifications.

source_semantic_checks.support: JSON generation, two-pass WSBASE placement, RAM/interface bounds and minimum-TPA check support the moved ranges. The arithmetic guard is not a boot or measurement.
Reads the matching native map/census/ROM, constructs recipes and publishes memory-map documentation. Font preflight precedes replacement. The notice companion does not change starter card membership.

Cold template is 40; PISTART requires Matrix enablement after the display probe and publishes the permanent record. Width selection accepts 80/40/32 and rejects active claims. VPAIR restores the saved interrupt state.
Complete staged preparation and display-piece rewriting preserve conditional pieces. Every selected PICO width gets an explicit line including 80. Failures leave staged edits unpublished.

Declarations and cold/warm clear boundaries support the changed lifetime and page-zero paragraphs. Allocation-vector slots and BDOS stub packing match the described rules. These sources do not reproduce historical map addresses.

Owner removal, declaration subtraction, page publication, failed-INIT cleanup and restart release support the changed references and stack limits. A retained failed installation is distinct from publication of records.
VCLAIM is separate storage. VIDEO stores CDCLM there and clears it on release. INFO ORs it with CONDEV into B. The corrected table properly omits stored CONDEV bit 4.
Caller-stack restoration, history-before-return ordering, later uppercase conversion and inherited program return word support the changed containing paragraphs.

The source asserts guarded high-water workloads, an LDIR exclusion, optional NMI triggering and quarter-stack bounds. GLCD declares 2/0/6 additional bytes. Neither reading constitutes a new passing run.

preservation.historical_boundary: 78127ec maps/captures, 58d4345 GLCD walkthrough, 60cfbdc and 5a25178 cache costs, 621201d GLCD dump and the independently qualified ea3 LINE evidence retain their original scopes. Chapter5 extraction keeps its separate 962/tested8b/receipt4b5b5a50 identities. No measurement or successful workflow is transferred by source equality.
preservation.corrective_table_changes: Chapter24 changes only two authorial semicolons to full stops in the historical layout table. Addresses, sizes and inline literals remain exact. Chapter25 deliberately removes the incorrect bit4 row and adds the separate VCLAIM/INFO explanation.
preservation.native_boundary: No historical 16018/366 map is replaced by current native 16020/364. Matching addresses are not used to transfer provenance.

editorial_assessment.changed_passages: Changed full passages preserve grammar, references and historical/current separation. Seven rewraps preserve literal and link adjacency. The corrective sentences explain storage before the combined INFO result.
editorial_assessment.reported_gates: Read the recorded gate findings/dispositions and changed-context complexity accounting. No new hard gate finding is reported. Existing untouched craft prompts are not reclassified as newly written reader prose. These utility records do not establish semantic or runtime correctness.
